worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.summary: Gape wide and compress a whole breath into concentric wavefronts that travel along the aim line: the front sweeps through a row of foes and keeps going into whoever stands behind them. The chain form instead gathers at the first foe and blooms over a ring around it.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.use.0: Pierce a row of foes lined up on one path
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.use.1: Sustain pressure from mid to long range
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.use.2: Chain form: bloom over a cluster around the first foe
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.descriptio: Each swept target takes %1$s special damage; the wavefront is %2$s blocks thick.
The wave reaches %1$s blocks, advances %2$s blocks per tick, and carries %3$s wavefronts.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.chain.on: Chain form: the wave gathers at the first target and deals %1$s special damage to foes within %2$s blocks around it.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.chain.off: Pierce form: it passes through up to %1$s more foes on the line.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.growth.0: From level %1$s the wavefront power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.growth.1: From level %1$s the wavefront power rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and pierce to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.preference: On: the wave gathers at the first foe and blooms over a ring around it (it stops there), with slightly lower power and a longer cooldown, good for a cluster. Off (pierce form, default): the wave keeps going through whoever stands behind, good for a line.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values fire first from further away.
On: prefer the pulse when other foes can be caught on the same line behind the target (may leave a better position to line it up). Off: treat it as an ordinary spell.
